headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 25, 2026**
article:
The Miami Marlins secured a thrilling 4-2 victory over the Texas Rangers, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Otto Lopez led the Marlins' offense with a 2-hit, 2-RBI performance, including a home run.

Several key players have been impacted by injuries, with Spencer Horwitz (Pittsburgh Pirates) placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left hamstring strain. Other notable injuries include Steven Matz (Tampa Bay Rays) with a left ankle sprain, Ryan McMahon (New York Yankees) with a throat infection, and Jaden Hill (Colorado Rockies) with right shoulder tendonitis.

The St. Louis Cardinals made a trade on June 23, 2026, sending RHP Chris Roycroft to the Tampa Bay Rays in exchange for a player to be named later. Other notable trades include the Houston Astros acquiring SS Marcus Brown from the Washington Nationals for cash, and the Chicago Cubs acquiring RHP Jayden Murray from the Houston Astros in exchange for 1B Cameron Sisneros.

top_news.title: **Cubs Cruise Past Mets 10-3**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs dominated the New York Mets, securing a 10-3 victory behind a strong performance from their offense. Dansby Swanson led the charge with a grand slam and 7 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Cubs Take Down Mets 10-5**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs secured a 10-5 victory over the New York Mets, with A.J. Ewing leading the offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 2 RBIs. Huascar Brazobán made a strong pitching appearance, striking out 4 batters in 2 innings with 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Guardians Edge White Sox in Thrilling 4-3 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Cleveland Guardians secured a narrow win over the Chicago White Sox, finishing with a final score of 4-3. Braden Montgomery led the Guardians' offense with a home run and two RBIs.
